summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first strategy, prioritising Asia Start and Intelligent China while managing immediate website and email deliverables.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the Intelligent China program, specifically Module 1 (Beijing, 1–4 December 2026, EV & Intelligent Mobility), which needs three separate web tabs to market effectively; Asia Start is also being pushed with a revised spotlight article. This week, the team must finalise the Tech in Asia recap email, update the Global Marcom work report with website/SEM/SEO sections, and resolve Outlook login issues across devices. The knowledge website redesign is progressing with a combined layout that removes the video section and integrates BCI/BSI indices. Upcoming, the team will coordinate Prof. Li Wei's session at the 2026中国企业出海交流大会, follow up with UN Women for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum, and evaluate attendance at the World Bank breakfast roundtable.
